high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of a tweet from the Twitter account "Defense of Ukraine" (@DefenceU). The tweet is dated February 27, 2024, at 7:25 PM. The tweet reads: "Oops, we did it again! Another Russian Su-34 fighter-bomber was destroyed by Ukrainian warriors in the eastern direction. And now it's 10 destroyed Russian planes in 10 days!" The tweet includes an image of a Russian Su-34 fighter-bomber aircraft in flight, with smoke or clouds surrounding it. The word "Destroyed" is prominently displayed
